mathematical_meanings: Left image: x denotes the unknown angle measure at D, in degrees. Right image: x denotes the unknown angle measure between BC and BO, in degrees.
Rationales: The left occurrence is located at x° at the lower-left vertex D; the right occurrence is at x° at B between BC and BO. Both use the selected notation for the same unknown-angle variable role. This compares the local role, without asserting that the two underlying objects or unknown values are identical.
